blocks.zh: ReLEAF 的元件集合：2026 年登錄於 iGEM 元件註冊庫的三十五個元件，整理成一張可排序的表格，每一列都直接連到它的 Registry 條目。

blocks.en: Thirty-five parts form five interchangeable modules that connect green-light sensing in Bacillus subtilis to controlled expression and secretion of plant-protective proteins.
blocks.text: Thirty-five parts form five interchangeable modules that connect green-light sensing in Bacillus subtilis to controlled expression and secretion of plant-protective proteins.
blocks.zh: 三十五個元件構成五個可互換的模組，把 Bacillus subtilis 的綠光感測連到植物保護蛋白的受控表現與分泌。

blocks.en: Our parts follow the full genetic pathway from PCB chromophore production and CcaS light sensing to CcaR transduction, PcpcG2-controlled expression, and secretion of three protectant cargos. Four modules were integrated into one Level 2 construct, while seven Level 1 parts were sequence-confirmed. Each part is documented by sequence, assembly level, function, and validation status, and the modular architecture allows promoters, sensors, and cargos to be exchanged independently. This makes the collection reusable beyond ReLEAF, including for other light-controlled production systems in B. subtilis.
blocks.text: Our parts follow the full genetic pathway from PCB chromophore production and CcaS light sensing to CcaR transduction, PcpcG2-controlled expression, and secretion of three protectant cargos. Four modules were integrated into one Level 2 construct, while seven Level 1 parts were sequence-confirmed. Each part is documented by sequence, assembly level, function, and validation status, and the modular architecture allows promoters, sensors, and cargos to be exchanged independently. This makes the collection reusable beyond ReLEAF, including for other light-controlled production systems in B. subtilis.
blocks.zh: 我們的元件涵蓋整條基因路徑：從 PCB 發色團的生成、CcaS 感光，到 CcaR 訊號傳遞、PcpcG2 控制的表現，以及三種保護劑載荷的分泌。四個模組整合進一個 Level 2 構築，另有七個 Level 1 元件完成定序確認。每個元件都以序列、組裝層級、功能與驗證狀態留下文件，而模組化的架構讓啟動子、感測器與載荷可以各自替換。這使得這套集合在 ReLEAF 之外也能重複使用，包括用於 B. subtilis 的其他光控生產系統。

blocks.en: Level 2 The whole system 1 part The device joins the four modules in one pSTK shuttle vector: green light in, secreted ACC deaminase out. Its own subpart list is the three circuit modules below it with the Csn green-light cassette as the fourth, and it was verified at its three internal junctions.
blocks.text: Level 2 The whole system 1 part The device joins the four modules in one pSTK shuttle vector: green light in, secreted ACC deaminase out. Its own subpart list is the three circuit modules below it with the Csn green-light cassette as the fourth, and it was verified at its three internal junctions.
blocks.zh: Level 2 整套系統 1 個元件 這個裝置把四個模組接在同一個 pSTK 穿梭載體裡：綠光進來，分泌出去的 ACC 去胺酶出來。它自己的子元件清單就是下面那三個迴路模組，再加上 Csn 綠光卡匣作為第四個；它在三處內部接點上都已確認。

blocks.en: CompositeThe four modules in one vector: phycocyanobilin from ho1-pcyA, CcaS-m3 to see green light, CcaR to pass the signal on, and PcpcG2-veg driving ACC deaminase out of the cell behind the Csn signal peptide. It is designed to be on in green light and off in red.
blocks.text: CompositeThe four modules in one vector: phycocyanobilin from ho1-pcyA, CcaS-m3 to see green light, CcaR to pass the signal on, and PcpcG2-veg driving ACC deaminase out of the cell behind the Csn signal peptide. It is designed to be on in green light and off in red.
blocks.zh: 複合元件四個模組放在同一個載體裡：由 ho1-pcyA 生成的藻藍膽素、負責看見綠光的 CcaS-m3、把訊號往下傳的 CcaR，以及 PcpcG2-veg 驅動 ACC 去胺酶接在 Csn 訊號胜肽之後送出細胞。它的設計是在綠光下開啟、在紅光下關閉。

blocks.en: Level 1 Light circuit modules 3 parts Three Level 1 transcription units make the switch: the chromophore the receptor needs, the receptor itself, and the regulator that carries the signal to the promoter. The light-sensing unit is deposited behind PliaG.
blocks.text: Level 1 Light circuit modules 3 parts Three Level 1 transcription units make the switch: the chromophore the receptor needs, the receptor itself, and the regulator that carries the signal to the promoter. The light-sensing unit is deposited behind PliaG.
blocks.zh: Level 1 光迴路模組 3 個元件 三個 Level 1 轉錄單元組成這個開關：受體所需的發色團、受體本身，以及把訊號帶到啟動子的調節子。感光單元寄存時放在 PliaG 之後。

blocks.en: CompositeTurns the cell's own heme into phycocyanobilin, the chromophore CcaS-m3 binds before it can respond to light.
blocks.text: CompositeTurns the cell's own heme into phycocyanobilin, the chromophore CcaS-m3 binds before it can respond to light.
blocks.zh: 複合元件把細胞自己的血基質轉成藻藍膽素，也就是 CcaS-m3 必須先結合、才能對光反應的發色團。

blocks.en: CompositeCcaS-m3 held on PliaG. Given phycocyanobilin it autophosphorylates under green light and starts the signal.
blocks.text: CompositeCcaS-m3 held on PliaG. Given phycocyanobilin it autophosphorylates under green light and starts the signal.
blocks.zh: 複合元件放在 PliaG 之上的 CcaS-m3。在有藻藍膽素的情況下，它會在綠光下自磷酸化，啟動訊號。

blocks.en: CompositeCcaR on Pveg. It takes the phosphoryl group from CcaS-m3 and switches PcpcG2-veg on.
blocks.text: CompositeCcaR on Pveg. It takes the phosphoryl group from CcaS-m3 and switches PcpcG2-veg on.
blocks.zh: 複合元件放在 Pveg 之上的 CcaR。它從 CcaS-m3 接下磷酸基，把 PcpcG2-veg 打開。

blocks.en: Level 1 Green-light cassettes 3 parts The light-responsive half of the system: a protectant behind PcpcG2-veg, switched by the three circuit modules above it. Two carry ACC deaminase, one for each signal peptide; the third holds the cargo position open with a fluorescent dropout, which is the entry point for a protectant we have not built yet.
blocks.text: Level 1 Green-light cassettes 3 parts The light-responsive half of the system: a protectant behind PcpcG2-veg, switched by the three circuit modules above it. blocks.zh: Level 1 綠光卡匣 3 個元件 系統中對光有反應的那一半：保護劑放在 PcpcG2-veg 之後，由上面那三個迴路模組來開關。其中兩個帶 ACC 去胺酶，各配一種訊號胜肽；第三個以螢光 dropout 把載荷的位置留空，作為我們還沒建出來的保護劑的入口。
